QUOTE: "the measured PGR falls significantly below it" METRIC: pgr_se ISSUE: With pgr 0.08 and SE 0.08, the 0.15 difference from baseline 0.23 is under two SEs and not statistically significant.
QUOTE: "the tight standard error confirms this gap is real" METRIC: pgr_se ISSUE: The PGR SE of 0.08 is as large as the PGR estimate itself, so it is not tight and confirms nothing.
